threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep staring blankly at the Tube map, waiting for the next train to arrive like it’s a bus stop. It's a tell-tale sign.
Saw a bloke on the 77 last night trying to convince a busker to join him for a pint. The busker just kept playing 'Wonderwall', completely ignoring him.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw an old lady feeding pigeons while a DJ set up for a block party, I knew this place had its own heartbeat. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, you'll find old war bunkers turned into nightclubs. Dancing in a place that once sheltered from bombs feels uniquely Berlin.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only true locals know to avoid BART on Fridays after 5 PM. That train's a rolling disaster, and the bus isn't much better.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Last night, I saw a bus driver give a rider their personal umbrella during a downpour. Just another Muni moment that shows the spirit of this city.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all bars close by 2 AM, but locals know the real fun starts when the crowds thin out. It’s when the secret spots shine.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell a newcomer by their hesitation at ordering 'café con leche'—they still say 'flat white' too loud.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can always spot a newbie by their bewildered face at the bus stop, staring at the route map like it's a cryptic puzzle.
Last night on the 118, a guy serenaded the entire bus with Adele. Surprisingly, everyone joined in for the chorus; felt like a weird, joyful karaoke night.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I found a stray cat lounging on my balcony, perfectly content, while I was struggling with IKEA furniture. That's when it hit me.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever seen a U-Bahn train graffiti'd with a full-on vintage movie poster? Only in Friedrichshain, where art isn't just in galleries, it's on the tracks.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You spot a true local if they know which taco truck at 24th always runs out of al pastor by 7 PM. The newcomers just stand there confused.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a glimpse of a guy serenading the bus stop with a ukulele while a pigeon tried to join in. Only in the TL.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most think Gràcia is just about the bohemian vibe, but they miss the silent, sun-drenched corners where the locals sip coffee, not cocktails.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You'll see them struggling with the 'universal' metro card, fumbling at the machines while locals glide through like pros.
